types.description: ABB OT250E03P switch-disconnector / 3-pole / front operated, pistol handle / 250 A / IEC 60947-3

document.title: ABB Switches — Switch-disconnectors OT and OTM (technical catalogue)
document.pages: p.10 technical data (OT160EV…800 E-frame); p.24 selection table (OT250E03P = 1SCA022710R0100); pp.72-73 dimension drawings

modelingNotes: Exact identity confirmed in an opened ABB source: catalogue 1SCC301020C0201 selection table p.24 row '3 | 250 | 250/250 | OT250E03P | 1SCA022710R0100', and ABB product data sheet 1SCC301020C0201 (Product ID 1SCA022710R0100, EAN 6417019225944). Bare switch-disconnector (isolator); not a fuse, fuse base, switch-fuse (OS/OSM) or motorised (OTM) type.

3-pole, front operated, base mounting, black IP65 pistol handle + shaft, terminal-bolt kit included. One handle opens/closes all three poles simultaneously (ganged). 'Special Functions: No' — no auxiliary contacts, motor or release in this order code.

Ratings (IEC 60947-3, AC utilization; conditional — not a single assigned circuit voltage): Ie = 250 A for AC-21A (380–1000 V), AC-22A and AC-23A (380–690 V); Ith/Ithe = 250 A @40 °C. AC-23A power: 75 kW@220–240 V, 145 kW@400–415 V, 170 kW@500 V, 250 kW@690 V. Ui = 1000 V; Uimp = 12 kV; Icw = 8 kA/1 s; Icm = 30 kA@690 V; power loss ≈ 6.5 W/pole. DC ratings not covered by reviewed documents. Only per-pole current capability (250 A) is placed on terminals; voltage capability is left in notes to avoid asserting a fixed supply voltage.

Manufacturer terminal markings were not established in the reviewed installation and dimension drawings. L1/L2/L3 and T1/T2/T3 are explicit functional authoring aliases for the two ends of each independent pole, not claimed inscriptions or an as-built phase assignment. The product data sheet permits Top In–Bottom Out or Bottom In–Top Out; these aliases do not require a fixed line/load direction.

No PE/earth terminal and no neutral in this 3-pole variant. A neutral link (OS_N3/OXN250), a 4th pole (OTZ250E), auxiliary contacts (OA1G10/OA3G01) and interlocks are separately ordered accessories; the 4-pole switch is a different order code (OT250E04P, 1SCA022710R0520). Base mounting is mechanical only and asserts no bonding path.

No permanent internal links: a switch pole must not be modelled as permanently joined merely because it conducts when closed. The three poles are mechanically ganged (operated together) but electrically independent switched paths. Terminals: lug type, 20 mm width, M8 bolt, 15…22 N·m; mechanical durability 20 000 operations.

connectionCoverage.notes: All six main electrical connection positions are represented by three ganged switched poles. Physical inscriptions and detailed terminal/accessory interfaces have not been established; L/T keys are functional aliases, and line/load orientation is reversible. No neutral, auxiliary contacts or PE terminal is added to the documented base-switch inventory. Optional accessories are separate orders.
